items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was somebody called Joe Calway or something that played with Anton Lada one time. [INTERVIEWEE] ... Yes, I remember now, Louisiana Five.

ctx.x: Oh yes, Anton Lada and Yellow Nunez. I'm trying to think of the – Anton Lada played drums, didn't he? Well I'm trying to think who the piano player was. Was it one of the Christian Broad Boys? Not that I know.
There was somebody called Joe Calway or something that played with Anton Lada one time.
Well they played at the Tokyo on 45th Off-Broadway there, the Tokyo Club. They had a right nice – Louisiana Five they called themselves. Yes, I remember now, Louisiana Five.
